root_idea.summary: The root develops two principal semantic orientations: sweet honey and agitation or vigorous movement.
root_idea.development: The lexical tradition distinguishes honey and what is derived from it from a second branch denoting quivering, rippling, agitation, and rapid movement; several figurative and derived usages develop from the honey branch.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is displayed under the normalized nominal citation form عَسَلٌ.

senses.definition: Honey, the sweet substance produced by bees.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used in the expression “purified honey” as one of the provisions described for Paradise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare or mix food with honey, making it sweet; also, to feed someone honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the object may be food or a person being provided with honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone an object of praise or love, or to dispose him to a good deed that wins praise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension comparing the pleasing effect of such a deed or reputation to honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extract honey from a bee-hive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal noun عَسْلٌ denotes the act of harvesting honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have sexual intercourse with a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or euphemistic Form I usage; the evidence supports the construction without restricting it to any particular object class beyond the stated construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To taste of someone’s food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْ in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To quiver or shake vigorously; of water, to become agitated and ripple.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a spear and other things that quiver, and of water disturbed by wind; related nominal and intensive forms describe repeated quivering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move rapidly, with wide steps or an agitated, bounding gait.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a wolf, horse, fox, man, or guide, and in an idiom meaning to keep going quickly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep or cleave to a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form I verb is also reported with the vocalization عَسَلَ بِالشَّيْءِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To provide honey as food or travelling provision, make a condiment into honey, or give food to divert and satisfy a guest before a meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative usage; the guest-diversion expression may refer more generally to food used to allay hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of bees, to make honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II usage with bees as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a Form II meaning, but the cited lexicographical report names no supporting authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek, request, or ask for honey as a gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An imprecation wishing someone stumbling and ruin; also, reviling in blame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression whose interpretation varies between the cited explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good manager and herder of cattle, camels, or other livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the possessive expression عِسْلُ مَالٍ or عِسْلُ مَالٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The like or equivalent of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression هٰذَا عِسْلُ هٰذَا, “this is the like of this.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flowers or blossoms, by association with the flowers from which bees make honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A marked figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sweet, thick juice of fruit, especially the juice flowing from fresh ripe dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension based on sweetness and honey-like consistency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sweet or honey-like plant exudate, including certain gums, tree resins, and a manna-like substance from shrubs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to named plant substances because of resemblance or association with honey; some cited exudates are not themselves sweet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or righteous deed whose resulting praise is considered sweet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun usage derived from the pleasantness associated with honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement in beating, with a hand or arm that is raised, falls, or returns rapidly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A source, origin, ancestry, parentage, or stock; by extension, a person’s known kindred or property base.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in idioms built on مَضْرِبُ عَسَلَةٍ and related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Honey-coloured; a thing having the colour of honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for the honey-coloured distinctive mark or garment historically associated with Jews.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small broom or feather used by a perfumer to gather or detach perfume.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to a hair broom or feather used on the perfumer’s paved floor or with a compound of perfumes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The penis of an elephant or camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Semen, whether that of a man or the seminal fluid of a man and woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage of the diminutive form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sweetness or pleasurable experience of sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A euphemistic expression in the cited prophetic formulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The male and female genital organs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural expression based on their being the means of sexual pleasure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bees, collectively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized collective noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hive or container in which bees make honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to a structure such as a vessel in which bees establish honey production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gatherer of honey from a hive or its place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial noun for the person who harvests honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place containing honey, such as a hive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive epithet describing a place by what it contains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or righteous person, or one who has a deed for which he is praised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative epithet; the form is explained as having the sense of one made an object of praise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wolf.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is associated with the wolf’s characteristic manner of running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swift she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is analyzed as derived from عَسَلَانٌ, the noun of rapid movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Resemblances, characteristics, and natural dispositions inherited from one’s father.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression هُوَ عَلَى أَعْسَالٍ مِنْ أَبِيهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A light sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Marked in the source as a vulgar or postclassical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A habitation of bees or beehive, whether manufactured or a natural cavity where bees deposit honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place associated with honey production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made or preserved with honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally, for example of ginger prepared with honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Honeyed or sweet in speech; by extension, faithful or reliable in promises.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of discourse, a person pleasing in expression or voice, and promises regarded as veracious.

cautions: The Quranic noun عَسَلٌ is the literal honey sense; the root’s separate agitation-and-rapid-movement branch should not be conflated with it.
The Form II meaning “to collect honey” is retained as a tentative Classical report because the supplied source explicitly notes that it gives no authority.
